# Reusable learning templates

Copy the appropriate template into a subject's numbered concept folder or its `practice/` folder. Name files descriptively, for example `my-sql-index-notes.md` or `two-sum-attempt.md`.

## Concept note

```markdown
# Topic
Date:
Status:
Prerequisites:
Source/reference:

## Explanation in my own words
## Small worked example
## Implementation link
## When to use it / when not to use it
## Failure and boundary cases
## Tradeoffs: correctness, complexity, latency, cost, security
## Mistake I made and how I fixed it
## Three questions to answer without notes
## Review dates: +1 day, +7 days, +30 days
```

## Problem solution

```markdown
# Problem
Input/output contract:
Constraints and examples:
Attempt date:
Hint used:

## Brute-force approach
## Improved approach and invariant/recurrence
## Why it is correct
## Time and space complexity
## Implementation and test links
## Boundary/failure cases
## What I missed
## Re-solve date and result
```

## Weekly review

```markdown
# Week N
Goal:
What I built (links):
What I can now explain without notes:
Test/demo evidence:
One unresolved problem:
One topic to revisit:
Next week's deliverable:
```
